Package com.example.thevms.model

Class Notification

java.lang.Object
com.example.thevms.model.Notification
public class Notification extends Object
Model class representing a notification in the system. Notifications are sent by organizers or the system to users (entrants).

  • Constructor Details

    • Notification

      public Notification()
      Default constructor required for Firebase Firestore deserialization.

    • Notification

      public Notification(String id, String title, String senderId, String senderName, UserRole senderRole, String receiverId, Date timestamp, String description)
      Constructs a new Notification.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique identifier for the notification (usually Firestore document ID).
      title - The headline of the notification.
      senderId - The device ID or user ID of the sender.
      senderName - The display name of the person or system sending the notification.
      senderRole - The role of the sender (e.g., ADMIN, ORGANIZER).
      receiverId - The device ID of the user who should receive this notification.
      timestamp - The date and time the notification was generated.
      description - The main content/message of the notification.

    • Notification

      public Notification(String id, String title, String senderId, String senderName, UserRole senderRole, String receiverId, String receiverName, Date timestamp, String description, String type, String eventId)
      Constructs a new Notification with a specific type and event ID.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique identifier for the notification.
      title - The headline of the notification.
      senderId - The device ID of the sender.
      senderName - The display name of the sender.
      senderRole - The role of the sender.
      receiverId - The device ID of the receiver.
      receiverName - The display name of the receiver.
      timestamp - The date and time of the notification.
      description - The main content of the notification.
      type - The type of notification (e.g., general, invite).
      eventId - The ID of the event associated with this notification.
